sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: Today Ganesha sees you overdoing your aggression, domination bit and urges you to keep your assertiveness in check. This day is not a favourable one for new ventures and undertakings. Don’t therefore attempt anything new. Talk pleasantly. Harshness, roughness in your tone is only going to antagonize and alienate valuable friends. Above all, don’t lose your temper. Stay calm. Act normal. Yoga and meditation will help.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: You're a person of many talents, and today you're likely to discover yet another one, Taurus. The delivery of a new piece of equipment makes you feel like you've been given a toy for your sole enjoyment. But once you get the computer or piece of machinery up and running, you need to share it with your co-workers! They will be very impressed with your technical abilities.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Plans go awry and force you to find a new strategy, dearest Taurus, as Mercury aspects the nodes of fate and Chiron. Try to view recent developments as an opportunity to improve your trajectory, rather than lamenting over visions that never came to pass. It's possible you've put too much pressure on yourself or others, causing your structures to collapse. Rebuild while considering how teamwork and healthy living can increase your chances of succeeding the next time around. Your psychic abilities intensify as the Moon continues through your sign. Take steps to protect yourself from outside influences or emotions when Luna squares Jupiter this evening.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Today you are under magic spell of hope. Increase in income from past investment is foreseen. Social activity in the evening will turn out to be much better than you expected. A surprise message will give you sweet dream. You will feel that your creativity has been lost and you find it extremely difficult to make decisions. Natives of this zodiac sign should read some spiritual books in their free time today. By doing this, many of your troubles can be overcome. Your married life is all about fun, pleasure, and bliss today.

readings.text: Today, you will share your ideas without a properly planned and thorough research. Therefore, you need to be sure about your speech while presenting your ideas to your superiors. The careful decision will keep you safe in front of your supervisor, says Ganesha.

Whether you are at work or not, you will feel a tremendous pressure to get certain tasks accomplished. If you are at home, attend to household jobs that you have wanted to get to for weeks. Today is the "rainy day" you've been waiting for.

Rebuild while considering how teamwork and healthy living can increase your chances of succeeding the next time around.

readings.text: In financial matters you may be out of luck today. Though you may be planning your finances for the long-term, you shall be all too conscious of the need to maintain stability and security.
You're a social butterfly capable of attracting just the right mix of business and pleasure into your life. Your pursuit of excellence in the mental arena is of primary importance.

bits.t: Increase in income from past investment is foreseen.

readings.text: Mood swings may adversely affect your work. Remain composed to divert your energy in the right direction. Time has come to give up your bad habits, once and for all. Meditate to stay cool and maintain your energy level, advises Ganesha.

Satisfying your natural urges is just what the doctor ordered this week. That's right - you are in charge of this! Try to focus on what you really want and then on giving it to yourself. Whether it's a walk by the beach to think over personal matters or a frank chat with your boss, there are certain things that only you can provide. You sometimes sink into the habit of thinking that what you want most deeply is something or some emotion only others can give you. Wake up from this coma and begin nurturing yourself!

bits.t: Rebuild while considering how teamwork and healthy living can increase your chances of succeeding the next time around.
Take steps to protect yourself from outside influences or emotions when Luna squares Jupiter this evening.

lucky.remedy: For a faster career growth, ensure that contaminated water is not collected in or around your home.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: There is a new beginning for you -- something you can really sink your teeth into.
